summary: Short voice-assistant commands in English covering seven everyday intents — playing music, booking a restaurant, checking the weather and so on. One row is one written command and its intent. Seven intents is a far smaller label space than the other English intent corpora here, and the public mirror carries no slot spans, so only intent recognition is scored.
notes: SNIPS voice-assistant queries (7 intents, English). Absorbed from ovos-intent-benchmark's dataset list — registered directly against the public HF mirror rather than copied. Text-only (no slot spans in this mirror), template-paradigm training only.
